zh-Hans: 星线是一道封印
en: The Starline Is a Seal
note: 档案馆条目标题

zh-Hans:
一千年前，大陆深处醒来一股吞食法力的饥饿，人们叫它永夜。人类法师和影歌精灵联手，把流星雨留下的法力水晶立在大地上，用一根根光带连成魔网，把永夜压在大陆尽头。这群人叫织网者，这张网就是星线。

这张网只用了两根线：人类法师的知识和精灵的信任。它没有把所有人连起来，只靠一名织网者在初源水晶里独自撑着。千年过去，人们忘了星线是封印，只记得它是城邦的灯火、结界和粮田的来源。
en:
A thousand years ago, a hunger that devours mana woke deep within the continent. People called it the Endless Night. Human mages and the Shadowsong Elves joined forces, raised the Mana Crystals left by a meteor shower across the land, and linked them with bands of light into a Mana Web that pinned the Endless Night at the edge of the world. They were called the Weavers, and their web was the Starline.

The web used only two threads: the knowledge of human mages and the trust of the elves. It did not connect everyone, and was held up by a single Weaver alone inside the Prime Crystal. A thousand years later, people had forgotten the Starline was a seal. They remembered only that it lit their cities, powered their wards and fed their fields.
note: 档案馆条目正文

zh-Hans: 断线日
en: Severance Day

zh-Hans:
王国纪元 412 年，银月法师塔的前任塔主莫德雷德打开了初源水晶。星线从源头开始被吸干，失去法力的城邦结界崩塌，死去的人被死气唤起，成为亡灵大军。这一天叫断线日。

亡灵不是天生的恶魔：它们是陷落城邦的居民和守军，记忆被死气封住，只剩下饥饿。
en:
In the Kingdom's year 412, Mordred, former master of the Silver Moon Tower, opened the Prime Crystal. The Starline was drained from its very source. Without mana, the cities' wards collapsed, and the dead were raised by the death-mist into an undead army. That day is called Severance Day.

The undead are not demons born. They are the people and soldiers of the fallen cities, their memories sealed away by the death-mist, leaving only hunger.
note: 第 6 章之前不能写出莫德雷德的真实动机

zh-Hans: 灯塔城
en: Lighthaven

zh-Hans:
星线最末端的边境城市，靠一座源晶塔撑了下来。源晶塔的水晶里住着一缕意识，名叫诺娃。她能预见战局，却记不起自己是谁。

断线日那一夜，源晶塔选中了一个人：只有这个人听得见诺娃的声音。这个人就是你，灯塔城新任的指挥官，持线人。
en:
A border city at the far end of the Starline that survived thanks to a single Source Spire. Within the Spire's crystal lives a presence named Nova. She can foresee the course of battle, but cannot remember who she is.

On the night of Severance Day, the Source Spire chose one person, the only one who can hear Nova's voice. That person is you: Lighthaven's new Commander, the Threadholder.
note: 指挥官不定性别，英文用 you

en: Nova says that to reweave the Starline, five threads are needed: Guardianship, Freedom, Knowledge, Redemption and Trust. One from each of the five factions.

en: Mordred's Notes

zh-Hans: 莫德雷德发现封印在衰竭。他不信任任何人，没有告诉学生，也没有去找精灵，而是想独自吞下初源水晶的力量，用自己去撑住封印。结果他成了第一个被永夜吞掉的人，也就是巫妖王。亡灵吞下的法力，一路被送往初源，喂给了永夜。
en: Mordred discovered the seal was failing. Trusting no one, he told neither his students nor the elves. Instead he meant to take the power of the Prime Crystal into himself and hold the seal up alone. He became the first to be swallowed by the Endless Night: the Lich King. All the mana the undead devour is carried back to the Prime, to feed the Endless Night.

zh-Hans: 最后一位织网者
en: The Last Weaver
note: 第 8 章后解锁

zh-Hans:
诺娃就是最后一位织网者。断线日那一夜，她从初源退到了星线最末端的这颗水晶里，用剩下的光护住灯塔城。一千年来，她一直用自己撑着残存的星线，所以她的光在一点点变暗。

重织星线需要有人把五根线打成一个结。她本打算成为那个结，永远留在初源。
en:
Nova is the last Weaver. On the night of Severance Day, she retreated from the Prime into this crystal at the far end of the Starline, and sheltered Lighthaven with the light she had left. For a thousand years she has held up what remains of the Starline with her own self, and so her light grows dimmer and dimmer.

To reweave the Starline, someone must tie the five threads into a single knot. She meant to become that knot, and stay in the Prime forever.
